title: Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Day Gel-Cream

seo.title: Copper Peptide Day Cream 2% (GHK-Cu) Gel-Cream
seo.description: Lightweight day gel-cream with 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu), vitamin C and hyaluronic acid. Hydrates all day under makeup and SPF for firmer, smoother-looking skin.

description_html:
A lightweight daily gel-cream with 2% Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) for hydrated, protected, healthy-looking skin under SPF and makeup.

  • 2% Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) - our hero active, with the percentage stated on the pack
  • Lightweight, fast-absorbing hydration for all-day wear
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: normal, combination and oily skin that wants lightweight daytime hydration under makeup and SPF.

Size: 50ml
custom.key_benefits:
- All-day hydration - lightweight gel-cream with triple hyaluronic acid
- Antioxidant protection - helps defend against daily environmental stress
- Supports firmness - copper peptide for a smoother, firmer-looking complexion
- Sits well under SPF & makeup - fast-absorbing and non-greasy
What to expect: soft, hydrated skin from day one; smoother, healthier-looking skin with daily use.
custom.how_to_use:
Use in the morning as the last leave-on step, after your serums. Warm a pea-sized amount and massage lightly over the face and neck. Always follow with SPF, then makeup if you wish - the lightweight, fast-absorbing texture sits comfortably underneath.
For a complete morning routine, apply after the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) Renewal Serum, then finish with SPF.
custom.clinical_research:
GHK-Cu, double-blind tested: 55.8% more wrinkle-volume reduction than the same serum without it.
GHK-Cu is a copper peptide your own body makes, first isolated from human plasma in 1973. In clinical research:
- 55.8% more wrinkle-volume reduction than the serum without it, measured by 3D skin imaging (40 women, 8 weeks)
- 7 in 10 people showed new collagen production after one month in a skin-biopsy study, vs 5 in 10 with vitamin C and 4 in 10 with tretinoin
- An independent 2026 systematic review found GHK-Cu significantly reduced wrinkle volume and depth compared with controls
Badenhorst et al. 2016, J Aging Sci (split-face, 8 weeks, funded by the tested serum's maker); Abdulghani et al. 1998; Mokhtar et al. 2026, Aesthetic Surgery Journal (two trials). Results describe the ingredient, not this product.
See every copper peptide study →

custom.faq_items.question: What does the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Day Gel-Cream do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A lightweight daytime gel-cream with 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu), vitamin C, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. It hydrates and supports firmer, smoother and more radiant-looking skin through the day. That is 20,000 ppm of copper peptide (GHK-Cu).

custom.faq_items.question: When and how do I apply it?
custom.faq_items.answer: In the morning, after your serum. Smooth a small amount over face and neck, then always finish with SPF 30+.

custom.faq_items.question: Can I use it with the Copper Peptide serum?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes, they are designed to pair. Apply the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Renewal Serum first, then this gel-cream to seal.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it a good moisturiser for oily or combination skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. The gel-cream texture is light and fast-absorbing, making it well suited to normal, combination and oily skin.

custom.faq_items.question: Does it replace sunscreen?
custom.faq_items.answer: No. It does not contain SPF. Always apply a separate broad-spectrum SPF 30+ as the last step of your morning routine.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance. We recommend a patch test first.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 1. Cleanse
custom.how_to_steps.description: Wash with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser and pat skin dry.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 2. Apply your serum
custom.how_to_steps.description: Apply your Skingenetix serum and allow it to absorb.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 3. Apply Day Gel-Cream + SPF
custom.how_to_steps.description: Smooth over face and neck in the morning, then finish with SPF 30+.
